description.zh: 桌面上的一条真 PowerShell：每条命令约 40ms，cd 会保留，输出一行一行回来。不是终端模拟器，跑不了 vim/ssh
description.en: A real PowerShell on your desktop: about 40ms per command, cd sticks, output arrives line by line. Not a terminal emulator: vim/ssh will not work

items.zh: 一张卡片，接在你自己的 PowerShell 上。命令真的在跑，目录和变量真的留着。
items.en: A card wired to your own PowerShell. Commands really run; the directory and variables really stay.

items.zh: 每个实例一条常驻 shell，不是每条命令起一个进程 —— 所以一条命令几十毫秒，而不是半秒。
items.en: One resident shell per instance instead of one process per command, so a command takes tens of milliseconds, not half a second.

items.zh: 它只是那条 shell 的一块皮肤：没有模拟终端，没有 ANSI 颜色，没有命令补全。
items.en: It is a skin over that shell: no terminal emulation, no ANSI colours, no completion.

items.zh: 要控制台的程序会挂住或者吐乱码：vim、top、ssh、python 的交互式 REPL。
items.en: Anything that wants a console hangs or garbles: vim, top, ssh, the interactive python REPL.

items.zh: 这是能力边界，不是 bug。要待在里面干活，请开一个真终端；这张卡片是顺手看一眼。
items.en: That is the boundary, not a bug. For work that lives inside a console, open a real terminal; this card is for a glance.

items.zh: 彩色输出会变成普通文字（PowerShell 在非交互模式下本来也不吐颜色）。
items.en: Coloured output becomes plain text; PowerShell in non-interactive mode would not colour it anyway.

items.zh: 跑着的命令旁边有一颗方块：按它等于杀掉这条 shell，下一条命令会自动起一条新的。
items.en: A square appears next to a running command: pressing it kills the shell, and the next command starts a fresh one.

items.zh: 杀掉会丢掉 cd 和变量 —— 没有控制台就没有 Ctrl+C，只能整条重来。
items.en: Killing loses the directory and variables; without a console there is no Ctrl+C, so it is all or nothing.

items.zh: 命令自己 exit 了，卡片会直说 shell 退出了，敲下一条就重开。
items.en: If the command exits the shell, the card says so; the next command starts a new one.

items.zh: 一条命令最多留 64KB，再多会丢掉并标上「已截断」。
items.en: A command keeps at most 64KB; more is dropped and marked as truncated.

items.zh: 卡片只显示最近 2000 行，滚动条往上翻得动，但更早的已经不在内存里了。
items.en: The card shows the last 2000 lines; you can scroll, but older ones are gone from memory.

items.zh: 行不会横向滚动：长行折行显示，拉到最宽也不会出现横向滚动条。
items.en: Nothing scrolls sideways: long lines wrap, even at the widest size.

items.zh: 「在终端里跑命令」这一项默认不给，授予它等于允许这个组件执行任意命令、读写你的文件。
items.en: Run commands is off by default; granting it lets this widget execute anything and reach your files.

items.zh: 平台不判断一条命令危不危险 —— 判断不了。所以请只装你信得过的组件。
items.en: The platform cannot judge whether a command is dangerous, so only install widgets you trust.

items.zh: 撤掉权限会重载卡片，正在跑的 shell 会跟着停。
items.en: Revoking the permission reloads the card, and the running shell stops with it.

items.zh: 命令历史存在组件自己的存储里（最多 200 条，最近的在最后），不进平台的 state.json。
items.en: Command history lives in the widget's own storage (up to 200, newest last), not in the platform's state.json.

items.zh: 历史按实例分开：画布上那份和桌面上那份各记各的。
items.en: History is per instance: the canvas copy and the desktop copy each keep their own.

items.zh: 上下箭头翻历史，回车执行；空行不会发出去。
items.en: Up and down walk the history, Enter runs; an empty line is never sent.

changes.zh: 第一个版本：每个实例一条常驻 PowerShell，命令输出一行一行回来，cd 保留。
changes.en: First release: one resident PowerShell per instance, output streaming back line by line, cd preserved.

changes.zh: 停一条命令 = 杀掉 shell 再起一条；命令历史留在组件自己的存储里。
changes.en: Stopping a command kills the shell and starts a new one; history stays in the widget's own storage.

changes.zh: 能力边界写在说明里：跑不了 vim/ssh，没有 ANSI 颜色，没有补全。
changes.en: The limits are documented: no vim/ssh, no ANSI colours, no completion.
